correctness.rationale: For any pure postcollision two-qubit state T=A−pρ is a traceless Hermitian charger matrix; a real qubit measurement basis with zero T diagonals gives equal conditional populations, then energy-diagonal feedback aligns pure battery phases exactly. Direct exchange-unitary calculation gives [F_−(e),F_+(e)], and the sustainable interval solves |eta(e−beta)|≤2√(eta(1−eta)beta(1−beta)e(1−e)). Differentiating F_+ at upper fixed point yields √(1−eta)(1−2beta), proving finite reachability iff beta>1/2; concavity proves no finite arrival below/equal, with linear versus quadratic rates. Independently checked fixed points, derivative, and constructive 3-step example for beta=0.8 eta=0.5 and other pairs; original check.py inspected with exact rational and resonant/nonresonant matrix checks, but logs do not replace the global proof.
